_comment: The scientific module: the curve shapes a measured profile is decomposed into - the peak shapes, the background shapes and the user's own formula - which free Fit links and a product for another field leaves out (fit/tools/build-lib/product_modules.ps1). Its types keep the owner 'Standard', the framework's own, so a peak, a background and a user's formula still go in one model. data: Fit's Data folder, its diffraction profiles 1.dat to 9.dat, which a package ships only for a product linking this module (Get-ProductSampleDirs). forms: the Free and Pro client's own windows for this module (Desktop/ScientificForms), which the module never names - linked only into a client that links it, through client_modules. server: the background arithmetic (background_search), which only the compute server links.
name: scientific
